'''R4-M1'''<ref name="The Soft War Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-soft-war-trivia-gallery|text="The Soft War" Trivia Gallery}}</ref> was an [[R4 astromech droid|R4 astromech]] [[droid]] who served the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. When [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Mace Windu]] were trapped in the wreckage of the ''[[Endurance]]'' at [[Vanqor]], [[R2-D2]], arriving at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]] to play their distress message, jostled the R4 unit as he sped past.<ref name="R2 Come Home" />

==History==
===Roaming the Temple===
In [[21 BBY]], R4 was roaming the temple with [[R5-S9]] when [[R2-D2]] bumped into them on his way to deliver a message.<ref name="R2 Come Home" />
